title: 第17章 从此我叶家气运散尽第18章 叶轩的奋斗史
slug: 叛出家族后转身投靠魔族女帝
lines: “楚尘少爷的月俸是”
在眾人的逼迫下，福伯硬著头皮就欲说出实情。
“父亲！”
可就在此时，一直沉默的叶轩突然开口，將在场之人的注意力拉到自己身上，並且不留声色地瞪了一眼福伯，以示警告。
福伯微微一愣，眼神中闪过一丝挣扎，却还是低著头后退两步。老老实实闭上嘴巴。
楚尘早已被剥夺圣子之位，且很有可能命丧妖兽之口，而叶轩却是叶家新的圣子，集万千宠爱於一身，未来成就不可限量。
他虽心中为楚尘感到不平，可为了一个已死之人去去得罪叶家圣子，
“小轩，你这是”
叶凌月皱了皱眉头，疑惑地看向叶轩，不知叶轩为何会在这个时候打断福伯。
印象中，叶轩是叶家为数不多对楚尘还算和善之人。
这三年，每每叶清清、叶寒和叶灵儿等人欺负楚尘时，叶轩总会站出来制止，替楚尘说好话，哄几个姐姐开心。
叶轩虽是叶家养子，但一口一个楚尘哥哥，丝毫没有因为楚尘修为被废而对他冷言嘲讽。
这一点就是当大姐的叶凌月，也比之不得，羞愧得无地自容。
秉性纯良、心思单纯。
想来这也是叶轩在叶家如此受欢迎，人人都喜欢的原因所在。
只是不知道叶轩为何在这时候打断福伯，难不成
叶凌月柳眉微蹙，其他叶家人也纷纷看向叶轩，一脸疑惑。
“父亲，姐姐们！”
“轩儿想说的是，楚尘哥哥为我叶家与魔族女帝林书望拼死一战，让我叶家得以晋升不朽世家不说，还阻止了正魔两道大战，生灵涂炭。”
“如此丰功伟绩，不世之功，就算就算给楚尘哥哥的月俸再多，那也是理所应当！”
叶轩拱手冲坐在家主之位上的叶鼎和周围几个姐姐行礼，隨即继续义正严词、大义凛然道：
“更何况我叶家能够掌管天下九十九条灵脉，也都是楚尘哥哥击败魔族女帝林书望的功劳，跟九十九条灵脉比起来，每个月给楚尘哥哥的灵石和丹药，又又算得了什么？”
“父亲，与其在这纠结楚尘哥哥的月俸有多少，轩儿觉得当务之急应该是找到楚尘哥哥，並把他带回叶家！”
活要见人，死要见尸，叶轩这朵白莲可不愿就此放弃。
楚尘要是死了，他以后掠夺谁的气运去？还怎么称霸叶家？横扫整个荒古大陆？？
“楚尘哥哥福大命大，轩儿相信即便没有护身道印在，楚尘哥哥也一定能逢凶化吉，逃出生天！”
说至激动处，叶轩眼眶一红，豆粒大的泪珠一滴接著一滴，顺著脸颊缓缓滴落。
静！
整个大殿死一般的寂静！
面对叶轩这一番慷慨激昂、深情厚谊的说辞，叶家人半张著嘴，激动的心情久久不能平復。
就连叶凌月看向叶轩的眼神，都变了又变。
本来因为楚尘生死未卜，叶凌月就对取代楚尘的叶轩有些许不满，可在叶轩那情真意切的一番说辞下，所有的不满荡然无存，有的只是感动。

"Master Chu Chen's monthly salary is"
Under the pressure of everyone, Fu Bo bit the bullet and wanted to tell the truth.
"Father!"
But at this moment, Ye Xuan, who had been silent all this time, suddenly spoke, drawing the attention of everyone present to himself, and glared at Uncle Fu silently as a warning.
Uncle Fu was slightly stunned, a trace of struggle flashed in his eyes, but he still lowered his head and took two steps back. Just keep your mouth shut.
Chu Chen has long been deprived of his position as the Holy Son, and is very likely to die at the mouth of a monster, but Ye Xuan is the new Holy Son of the Ye family. He is loved by thousands of people and his future achievements are limitless.
Although he felt aggrieved for Chu Chen in his heart, he still wanted to offend the holy son of the Ye family for the sake of a dead person.
"Xiaoxuan, what are you doing?"
Ye Lingyue frowned and looked at Ye Xuan doubtfully, wondering why Ye Xuan interrupted Uncle Fu at this time.
In my impression, Ye Xuan is one of the few people in the Ye family who is kind to Chu Chen.
In the past three years, whenever Ye Qingqing, Ye Han, Ye Ling'er and others bullied Chu Chen, Ye Xuan would always stand up and stop them, say nice things for Chu Chen and make his sisters happy.
Although Ye Xuan was the adopted son of the Ye family, he looked like Chu Chen's brother and did not sneer at Chu Chen because his cultivation was abolished.
Even the eldest sister Ye Lingyue couldn't compare to this, and was so ashamed that she felt ashamed.
He has a pure nature and a simple mind.
I think this is why Ye Xuan is so popular in the Ye family and everyone likes him.
I just don’t know why Ye Xuan interrupted Uncle Fu at this time. Could it be that
Ye Lingyue frowned slightly, and the other Ye family members also looked at Ye Xuan with doubts on their faces.
"Father, sisters!"
"What Xuan'er wants to say is that Brother Chu Chen fought to the death for my Ye family and the demon empress Lin Shuwang, which not only allowed my Ye family to be promoted to the immortal family, but also prevented the good and the evil from fighting, and the lives of all people were devastated."
"With such great achievements and unparalleled achievements, no matter how much monthly salary I give to Brother Chu Chen, it is still deserved!"
Ye Xuan raised his hands and saluted Ye Ding, who was sitting on the head of the family, and several sisters around him, and then continued to speak sternly and solemnly:
"What's more, my Ye family's ability to control the ninety-nine spiritual veins in the world is all due to brother Chu Chen's defeat of the demon empress Lin Shuwang. Compared with the ninety-nine spiritual veins, what are the spiritual stones and elixirs given to brother Chu Chen every month?"
"Father, instead of worrying about how much brother Chu Chen's monthly salary is, Xuan'er feels that the top priority should be to find brother Chu Chen and bring him back to the Ye family!"
You want to see people alive, you want to see corpses when you die, Ye Xuan, the white lotus, is not willing to give up.
If Chu Chen dies, whose luck will he plunder in the future? How to dominate the Ye family? Sweeping the entire ancient continent? ?
"Brother Chu Chen is blessed with great fortune. Xuan'er believes that even if there is no protective seal, brother Chu Chen will be able to turn danger into good luck and escape!"
Speaking of excitement, Ye Xuan's eyes turned red, and tears as big as peas fell one after another, slowly dripping down his cheeks.
quiet!
The whole hall was deathly silent!
Facing Ye Xuan's impassioned and affectionate remarks, the Ye family members half-opened their mouths, and their excitement could not calm down for a long time.
Even the way Ye Lingyue looked at Ye Xuan changed again and again.
Originally, because Chu Chen's life and death were uncertain, Ye Lingyue was a little dissatisfied with Ye Xuan, who replaced Chu Chen, but under Ye Xuan's sincere words, all dissatisfaction disappeared, and some were just moved.
title_en: Chapter 17 From now on, the luck of my Ye family is gone Chapter 18 The history of Ye Xuan’s struggle
